content: Root cause: The bug was caused by an infinite loop in the packet handling logic of the vhost_net driver when the receive (rx) buffer was too small for incoming packets. Specifically, if a malicious virtual machine (VM) allocated a very small buffer (1 byte) and another VM sent packets rapidly, the driver would continuously discard the packets and retry without a proper exit condition, leading to a potential denial of service (DoS) situation. The fix involved adding checks against the weight of packets processed to prevent this infinite loop and similar scenarios.
